main_app.app_subtitle: Your Comprehensive Guide for Solar System Design & Setup

voltage.title: Voltage
voltage.analogy: Like water pressure in a pipe; higher pressure pushes electricity stronger.
voltage.practical_tip: Select system voltage (12V, 24V, or 48V) based on system size to minimize loss.

current.title: Electric Current
current.analogy: Like the actual volume of water flowing through the pipe per second.
current.safety_rule: High current requires thicker cables to prevent overheating and fire risks.

power.title: Electrical Power
power.concept: Voltage multiplied by Current (Power = Voltage × Current).

acid.name: Flooded Lead-Acid Batteries
acid.desc: Uses liquid electrolyte and requires regular distilled water refilling. Lower initial cost, but shorter lifespan and maximum 50% recommended depth of discharge.

gel.name: Gel / AGM Batteries (Sealed)
gel.desc: Sealed, leak-proof batteries requiring zero maintenance. Ideal for medium home setups with a recommended 50% depth of discharge.

lithium.name: Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4)
lithium.desc: The top choice for modern systems; features extremely long lifespan (3500+ cycles), rapid charging, and safe discharge depth up to 80%-90%.

mono.name: Monocrystalline Panels
mono.desc: Features a dark black uniform look with top efficiency. Ideal for limited roof spaces and areas with weaker sunlight conditions.

poly.name: Polycrystalline Panels
poly.desc: Recognizable by its blue speckled look. Offers good performance at a lower cost, best suited for larger spaces and average budgets.

flexible.name: Flexible & Lightweight Panels
flexible.desc: Ultra-thin and bendable solar panels, perfect for curved surfaces, RVs, and mobile applications. Easy to carry but has a shorter lifespan.

battery_calc.no_consumption_warning: ⚠️ No loads set, calculations are based on default values
battery_calc.conn_parallel: Parallel Connection ({{requiredParallel}} batteries to increase capacity)
battery_calc.safety_warning: ⚡ Warning: Always use heavy-duty copper cables and dedicated DC breakers to protect the system.
battery_calc.conn_single_reason: A single battery is sufficient to cover system capacity and required voltage without additional wiring.
battery_calc.conn_mixed_reason: {{series}} connected in series to reach {{voltage}}V system voltage, combined with {{chains}} in parallel to meet required total capacity ({{capacity}} Ah).
battery_calc.conn_series_reason: Connected in series to step up voltage from {{singleVoltage}}V to the required system voltage ({{voltage}}V) while maintaining constant battery capacity.
battery_calc.conn_parallel_reason: Connected in parallel to double the total capacity to {{capacity}} Ah for load coverage, keeping bank voltage identical to system voltage ({{voltage}}V).

inverter_settings.header_subtitle: Off-grid inverter charging and voltage cut-off parameters

01.name: Output Source Priority
01.desc: Configures power source priority for connected loads (SBU, SUB, SOL, UTI).

02.name: Maximum Charging Current
02.desc: Total maximum charging current combined from solar PV and utility grid/generator.

03.name: AC Input Voltage Range
03.desc: Sets input AC voltage range acceptance: APL (Appliance mode/Generators) or UPS (sensitive electronics).

05.name: Battery Type
05.desc: Selects battery chemistry type: Lithium (Li), User-Defined (USE), AGM, or GEL.

06.name: Auto Restart When Overload Occurs
06.desc: Enables or disables automatic system restart when an overload event happens.

07.name: Auto Restart When Overtemperature Occurs
07.desc: Enables or disables automatic restart once inverter cools down from overtemperature.

09.name: Output Frequency
09.desc: Sets the grid/inverter output AC frequency (50Hz or 60Hz).

10.name: Output Voltage
10.desc: Sets the nominal AC output voltage (220V, 230V, or 240V).

11.name: Maximum Utility Charge Current
11.desc: Maximum charging current supplied from utility grid or AC generator only.

12.name: Setting Voltage Point Back to Utility
12.desc: Battery voltage threshold to automatically switch load power back to the grid/utility.

13.name: Setting Voltage Point Back to Battery
13.desc: Battery voltage threshold to switch back to battery discharge mode after recharging.

16.name: Charger Source Priority
16.desc: Configures charger priority: Solar first (CSO), Solar & Utility (SNU), or Solar only (OSO).

18.name: Alarm Control
18.desc: Turns the audible buzzer/beeper alarm on or off.

19.name: Auto Return to Default Display
19.desc: Automatically reverts LCD display screen back to primary default screen after inactivity.

20.name: Backlight Control
20.desc: Enables LCD display backlight to stay continuously ON or turn off after inactivity.

22.name: Beep When Primary Source Interrupts
22.desc: Enables alarm beep notification when primary power source is interrupted.

23.name: Overload Bypass
23.desc: Enables switching to utility power automatically when unit suffers an AC overload.

26.name: Bulk Charging Voltage (C.V)
26.desc: Target constant voltage for fast charging phase (Bulk/Absorption).

27.name: Floating Charging Voltage
27.desc: Maintenance float voltage to keep battery fully charged without overcharging.

29.name: Low DC Cut-off Voltage
29.desc: Low battery voltage threshold at which inverter disconnects output to prevent deep discharge.

30.name: Battery Equalization
30.desc: Enables or disables periodic battery equalization charge mode.
